ops.title: Autoresearch outer loop + ai-trains-ai hardening (A1–A8): contract memory, preflight, failure split, baselines, retros, policy-bounded autonomous campaign, watchdog, consumer unblockers
ops.description: Approved program (cc-steer plan lets-see-what-we-synchronous-cookie.md, 2026-07-16), adopting mechanisms from github.com/Danau5tin/ai-trains-ai. A1 contract memory + frozen baseline (Memory in research/contract.py, seed incumbent_metric — deliberate first-keep semantics change). A2 mandatory preflight (research/preflight.py + train/preflight.py; globs bind, metric scores incumbent, stability, opt-in known_good_dir reachability). A3 infra-vs-candidate failure split (research/failures.py; sidecar .events.jsonl, never the row journal; retries ≤2 then loud InfraFailure). A4 BaselineStore keyed by Comparability + floored uplift(). A5 retros via bound-backend generate() (never run_verdict/SpendGrant). A6a ProposalPolicy/validate_proposal (verbatim-template + bounded-by-refusal invariant; max_usd/max_wall_s mandatory in auto mode). A6b campaign runner: reservation-based cumulative caps, append-only Ledger, stop-flag kill switch, auto-retro-or-abort, consecutive-failure abort; gated mode as config knob. A7 quiet-alarm watchdog (LOCK_SH probe + byte-offset high-water mark). A8 consumer unblockers for cc-steer: 9B base + price in BASE_MODELS, mirror_cc_notes passthrough in loop.run; then release. Security-model doc gains an 'Autonomous outer loop' section. FULLY AUTONOMOUS UNDER CAPS is the design target.

ops.text: A1–A4 + A8 landed with tests green; release tagged and live on PyPI so cc-steer can pin the 9B entry
Toy-repo campaign e2e: 3 experiments under max_total_usd, reservation refuses a 4th, meta stop halts at the boundary, out-of-policy proposals ledger rejected with specific ProposalViolation reasons
No contract or retro prompt contains run-log bytes (lying-stdout fixture tripwire in tests)
Watchdog alarms on a frozen journal with a held lock; silent when no run is live
